Dear purchasers of "Like Dreamer BETA"


To those who participated in "Indie Games Connect 2022" hosted by KONAMI, thank you very much for your participation.
Thank you very much for your hard work.

Thank you very much for visiting the booth of our circle "Outside" and for downloading "Like Dreamer BETA Steam".
and for purchasing "Like Dreamer BETA Steam Download Card".
Thank you very much for visiting our booth and purchasing "Like Dreamer BETA Steam Download Card".

This version is a beta test version of "Like Dreamer".
We are looking forward to your feedback on the game until the full version of the game is released in the summer of 2022.
This version of the software is a beta test version of "Like Dreamer" and is intended to solicit your feedback on the game until the full version is released in the summer of 2022.

The content of the beta version is almost the same as the full version.
Please note that the software will not be updated to the full version or have any problems fixed.
Please note that no updates or bug fixes will be made to the full version.

If you have played the game
If you have played the game, please let us know your impressions, bug reports, requests, etc.
We would appreciate it if you could write your impressions, bug reports, requests, etc. in the review or on the community page.

Please be as specific as possible in your bug report, describing the situation and playing environment.
We will do our best to improve the game to the best of our ability.

Toward the release of the full version
Thank you very much for your cooperation.


Outside Representative
Sotonohito
